Andrew was born before 1747. He is the son of [[Glasgow-81|John Glasgow]] and [[Guthrie-777|Magdalene Guthrie]].

=== Possible Andrew Glasgow, Leith society and merchant notices, 1779–1790 ===
Andrew Glasgow is a named signatory in a Leith and St Anthony’s journeymen-society notice dated 3 February 1779, under the grouped Preses to annotation.<ref>[https://www.newspapers.com/image/601805253/ The Edinburgh Advertiser, 1779-02-09, p.7].</ref>

Andrew Glasgow, merchant in Kirkgate, Leith, is named as a contact where impost warrants may be obtained.<ref>[https://www.newspapers.com/image/601818940/ The Edinburgh Advertiser, 1790-12-07, p.3].</ref><ref>[https://www.newspapers.com/image/601819059/ The Edinburgh Advertiser, 1790-12-10, p.2].</ref>

The grouped annotation "Preses to" does not independently identify Andrew’s society or trade. The Leith name and place make the 1779 and 1790 occurrences compatible, without proving that they concern the same man. Being a contact for warrants does not establish that he held a tax office.

This may concern [[Glasgow-1333]]. Uncertain before 11 January 1747 West Calder birth allows an adult; no society identification.

=== Possible Robert Glasgow and father Andrew, miller at Calder, 1772 ===
Robert Glasgow is listed as son of Andrew Glasgow, miller at Calder, in an Edinburgh magistrates’ notice dated 28 November 1772.<ref>[https://www.newspapers.com/image/395731868/ The Caledonian Mercury, 1772-11-28, p.3].</ref><ref>[https://www.newspapers.com/image/395732022/ The Caledonian Mercury, 1772-11-30, p.3].</ref>

The notice directly identifies its Robert as the son of Andrew, miller at Calder. It does not distinguish East from West Calder or identify the mother. The two newspaper issues repeat the same family statement, not independent evidence of the later profile identities.

This may concern [[Glasgow-1333]]. For the named father Andrew, Uncertain birth before 11 Jan 1747 and West Calder location are chronologically possible for a father of an adult/younger Robert by 1772, but this is only a broad place-name match. The recorded current father is John-81, derived from the family tree; no miller evidence is recorded.
